title: Monitoring quality drift
goals: Explain the mechanism and terminology of monitoring quality drift
Apply the stated procedure to a new case with a traceable result
Identify an assumption or limitation and design a revealing follow-up
vocabulary: The declared interval or batch for measurement
A change in data or behaviour relative to a reference

blocks.text: 90% versus70%, drop20 percentage points; new window breaches80%. Check case mix, data versions and logs before asserting model drift as the cause.

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
An alert identifies a condition for investigation, not a complete causal explanation.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: For each window report eligible counts, passes, missing outcomes and condition mix. Alert when success falls below the toy80% threshold; investigate before attributing cause.
